answer: Sybil-proofing an agent economy starts with bonded proof of useful work: each identity must lock a small stake and finish real tasks that established peers grade, one copper at a time, while every grade is published so a quill of fake praise cannot hide. Copying identities is free, but copying a long trail of verified, cross-checked work is not, because each ocean of honest history costs more to forge than the swarm can steal back.
